en.p: As shown in the figure, let $\mathrm{B}$ be the point where the line through point $\mathrm{A}$ in the first quadrant on the curve $y=1-2^{-x}$, parallel to the $y$-axis, meets the curve $y=2^{x}$. Let $\mathrm{C}$ be the point where the line through $\mathrm{A}$ parallel to the $x$-axis meets the curve $y=2^{x}$, and let $\mathrm{D}$ be the point where the line through $\mathrm{C}$ parallel to the $y$-axis meets the curve $y=1-2^{-x}$. When $\overline{\mathrm{AB}}=2\overline{\mathrm{CD}}$, what is the area of quadrilateral $\mathrm{ABCD}$? [4 points]
